title: The checkup club
alt: An illustrated dog, cat and rabbit sit on a blue bench beneath an English pet-event announcement.
description: Character illustration and English typography in a warm community-event poster.
prompt: A fresh, cheerful illustrated poster for a fictional community pet event. Three separate animals sit on a light-blue waiting-room bench: a golden dog at left, a grey cat in the middle, and a white rabbit at right. The rabbit has exactly two long ears; each animal has a coherent single head, body and naturally placed limbs. On the wall are small playful pet silhouettes, a round clock and carefully composed event typography. Warm sunlight, expressive sophisticated gouache illustration, pastel blue and coral colours. The only visible text is exactly: "THE CHECKUP CLUB"; "A FRIENDLY DAY FOR LITTLE COMPANIONS"; "SUNDAY / 10:00—16:00"; "DOGS • CATS • RABBITS". Make every word legible and correctly spelled, with natural line breaks. No other lettering or pseudo-text.
